spot.name: Spot
spot.synergyNotes: Visual perception, noticing movement in periphery, discerning disguised figures, or reading lips. Opposed by Hide, Disguise, and Sleight of Hand.

actions.name: Spot Hidden Creature or Hazard
actions.description: Reactive or active check to detect hidden creatures or concealed hazards.

actions.name: Read Lips from Afar
actions.description: Understand what someone is saying by watching mouth movements within 30 feet in clear line of sight.
